title: Five Brooks Stable

services.name: Guided Trail Rides
services.desc: This is your destination for the most beautiful trail rides in Olema Valley and Point Reyes National Seashore! Enjoy breathtaking mountain views and coastal areas while riding along ridges and beaches! It is the ultimate getaway for horseback riding and relaxing for the whole family! This is a great ride for beginners and youngsters, as well as, nature lovers. Slow paced trail ride leading into an “Enchanted Forrest”. View Olema Valley as you pass through redwood groves and moss covered towering Douglas fir trees that reveal peeks of the Pacific

blurb: Five Brooks is a full service riding stable for the whole family. There are activities for all ages and kinds of Buckaroos and Buckarettes who wish to enjoy the magnificent Point Reyes National Seashore in the company of their equine
